name: Mondoñedo (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with a yellow chalice surmounted by a white host, between six white crosses, three at the hoist and three at the fly.
history: The arms and flag of Mondoñedo were officially rehabilitated on 9 December 1999, published in the Diario Oficial de Galicia on 29 December 1999; on a red cloth, the yellow chalice surmounted by the white Sacred Host and accompanied by six white crosses, three at the hoist and three at the fly.
